run.researchNotes: Top-up, 16 Nov 2026, 12 further searches. Competition rebuilt on one metric and one date: each bank's reported advances at 31 Mar 2026 divided by RBI SCB bank credit of Rs 2,13,61,435 cr at 31 Mar 2026; eleven named banks cover 82.5%. Caveat: bank figures are global/gross advances (SBI, BoB, PNB, Canara, BoI, Indian Bank include overseas books; Kotak is net) while the RBI total is domestic, so named shares are modestly overstated and the residual understated. Bank of India: Rs 7.71 lakh cr gross (management call) used over Rs 7,40,314 cr (JM Financial, likely net). TAM corrected: the earlier 21,290,000 was non-food credit; total bank credit at 31 Mar 2026 is 21,361,435 (RBI). SAM set to non-food credit, excluding food credit (FCI/state procurement consortium lending allocated outside competitive markets). Global growth: no source found on McKinsey's revenue basis for 15y, 10y, 5y or 3y CAGR; y5 given is IBISWorld's Global Commercial Banks revenue CAGR 2020-2025 (4.3%); MarketLine puts global bank ASSETS CAGR 2020-2025 at 5.0%; y15, y10 and y3 not found and omitted. Forecast: only consultancy forecasts found; TechSci's commercial-banking market forecast of 11.47% CAGR 2025-2031 is used but is on a narrower market definition ($3.2tn in 2025) and runs well above the 4-5% historical rates, so treat it as an outlier. The three bank-GROUP rows sent earlier (Public sector banks 54.4, Private sector banks 40.6, Foreign/SFB/other 5.0, Dec 2025) are on a different metric and period and should be dropped from competition.players; they do not match these bank names, so a merge by name would keep them.

growthForecast.source: TechSci Research, Global Commercial Banking Market report (USD 3,202.88bn in 2025 to USD 6,144.53bn by 2031); consultancy estimate, different basis from McKinsey revenue

tam.basis: the whole Indian market: total scheduled commercial bank credit (food + non-food)
tam.source: RBI, Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit (Section 42 return), outstanding as on 31 Mar 2026
tam.method: Reported RBI aggregate; replaces the earlier 21,290,000, which was non-food credit

sam.basis: the part listed banks compete for: non-food bank credit
sam.source: RBI, Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit, outstanding as on 31 Mar 2026
sam.method: TAM less food credit (Rs 70,271 cr), which is consortium lending to FCI/state procurement agencies allocated outside competitive markets

competition.metric: share of scheduled commercial bank credit (each bank's reported advances / RBI total bank credit)

marketTotal.source: RBI, Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit, bank credit outstanding 31 Mar 2026

players.name: State Bank of India
players.basis: bank's reported advances as % of SCB bank credit
players.source: CALCULATION: Gross advances (whole bank incl. foreign offices), 31 Mar 2026: Rs 49,32,627 cr - SBI FY26 results / RBI bank credit Rs 2,13,61,435 cr
players.moat: Largest deposit franchise (~22% share) and branch network; lowest-cost government and salary flows; FY26 ROE 18.57%.
players.whyLeader: Scale plus sovereign trust held share through the 2015-2020 NPA clean-up; FY26 gross advances +16.87%.
